svg.title: Systems under construction
svg.desc: Three systems. KIO, an orchestration runtime advanced through audited gates and built on the AURA memory runtime, has finished convergence gates C-1 to C-3 and is on C-4. UEA routes engineering work through a keyword classifier first, uses an optional local model only for unknown tasks, then verifies in tiers. gh-ops runs six GitHub operations jobs through one dispatcher in CI and locally and sends a Telegram brief only when a run found something meaningful.
